decisions.reason: Because it remains close to our crewing capabilities and customer base, and no clear performance shortfall is shown, we would keep it while continuing to learn whether it reaches our aspirations.

The programme extends our established training activities and the early expansion to six partner institutions suggests performance at least consistent with aspirations, so organisational slack supports retention.
This service is very close to our core offer and the successful on-time submission of all required plans indicates results above aspiration, making withdrawal highly unlikely.

Although market results are still early and uncertain, the dashboard fits our digitalisation strategy, is integrated into our existing software, and serves a growing compliance need, so we would keep it.

The simulation tool also builds on our established software and emissions-compliance capabilities, and with slack and strong regulatory demand we would continue it despite limited outcome evidence so far.
